name: Seattle Children's Hospital Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Weekly volunteer shifts at the hospital and regional clinics. Roles vary; see the position summaries on the volunteer site.
who_can_apply: People 16 and over for some positions and 18 and over for others. You must meet the minimum age when you apply.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Volunteers get a badge and free on-site parking.
duration: Most shifts are 3 hours on the same day and time every week; at least 6 months in a row (check each role)
deadline_text: Applications open each March, July and November and stay open until positions are filled. The site lists the next open date (not read).
how_to_apply: Apply online during an open period (you have one hour to finish), complete online training and forms within 2 weeks, do a 1-hour virtual group interview, then accept a placement. Onboarding includes a Washington State background check, an in-person health screening and a 90-minute orientation. Email VolunteerServices@seattlechildrens.org or call 206-987-4655.
notes: The youth service projects page (for ages under 16, such as donation drives or junior guilds) still carries a COVID-era notice, so it may be out of date. Nearly all shifts are weekdays starting between 9am and 2pm. Washington L&I says its child labor rules 'only apply to minor employees, not volunteers.'
